overall: 14 of 18 rows confirmed. Two are discrepancies and two still blocked; none failed. The serious problem is in me-statutes-justia: the part-less URL pattern served the 2013 edition for 22 M.R.S. § 4002, so a run could quote stale text without noticing. me-constitution-justia's consar{n} pattern fails for Article IV (Parts are consar41-43). Minor issues: rule probe headings match the TOC first; the LII pattern ignores Roman sub-chapters (10-144 ch. 101); /lawcourt/{current year}/index.html is a 404. Regex misses: prose 'section N of Title T' and '2023 Me. Laws, c. 405' (comma before c.). Official routes (Revisor, courts.maine.gov, lldc) all reproduced by script.
